name: Platform-cloudflare-kv cache-aside helper
purpose: The cache-aside helper wraps a domain-origin call with the facade. It is the shipped shape for a read-through cache: reads local first, invokes origin on miss, writes back with the elicited TTL, and returns the fresh value. TTL floor (1 second) is enforced at this seam so a misconfigured project cannot ship a sub-second TTL through cache-aside (ADR-3202).
responsibilities: Read local first via facade.get(key); on hit, return the cached value with source cache (AC-31105-1).
On miss, invoke originFn once; write back via facade.put with the effective TTL (elicited default 60 seconds per ADR-3202); return the fresh value with source origin (AC-31105-1).
After the TTL elapses, re-invoke origin on the next read (AC-31106-1).
Enforce the TTL floor of 1 second on every call; no per-call TTL below 1 second reaches the facade (ADR-3202).
internalStructure: One module exporting a createCacheAside({ facade, defaultTtl }) factory returning an object with a getOr(key, originFn, options?) method. The helper closes over the facade and the default TTL; per-call TTL overrides are floored to 1 second.
